prompt: Implement escape_field(text) in solution.py. Replace each original backslash with two backslashes, each tab with the two characters backslash and t, each newline with backslash and n, and each carriage return with backslash and r. checks:

prompt: Repair both files. codec.encode(value) must produce compact JSON with sorted object keys and literal Unicode characters. api.render(values) must use codec.encode for each value and join results with one newline. Return an empty string for empty input and never add a final newline.
checks:
from codec import encode
from api import render
import json
values = [{'z': 'kůň\n"x"', 'a': '\\path'}, [True, None]]
expected = [json.dumps(v, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')) for v in values]
assert [encode(v) for v in values] == expected
assert render(values) == '\n'.join(expected)
assert render([]) == ''
assert [json.loads(line) for line in render(values).splitlines()] == values
